author: DEVCITY 26
style: Flat sticker drawings with a thick ink outline. Map markers, badges, avatars, and the emoji set are hand-built SVG. The empty-state courier is an original generated illustration in the same three colors.
fontLicense: Nunito and DM Sans are loaded with next/font from Google Fonts.

contrast.notes: White text is used on the primary. Ink text is used on the secondary, the accent, and the paper. Teal and orange do not use white body text.
